title: Prose for a Painting
answer_short: The generated English poem may not work well with Shakespeare style transfer when the style transfer dataset does not have similar words in the training set of sentences.
answer_rationale: The authors explicitly state in the 'Limitations' section that without an end-to-end dataset, the generated poem may not align well with Shakespearean style, particularly when the style transfer dataset lacks similar words in the training set. This limitation is illustrated with 'Starry Night' as an example with a low content score.
